notes.title: Three new playable characters
notes.notes:
Introducing 3 new playable characters: Reaper, Princess, and Fatty

Reaper:
- Deals no damage, but has a chance of instantly killing enemies

Princess:
- Heals herself and allies with certain spells

Fatty:
- Specializes in close combat

notes.title: Horde Survivor Launch Gameplay
notes.notes: Watch us play Horde Survivor as we try to survive through endless waves.

notes.title: Horde Survivor Live Demo Gameplay
notes.notes:
Come check out live gameplay of the demo for Horde Survivor. This demo will include 4 of the playable characters that will be included in the main game. So if you want to see some action join me on stream.

Play the demo and Wishlist the game!

Thank you for all the support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738910/Horde_Survivor/

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where replacing the spell "Shield" on the warrior would cause an error.
[*] Fixed a bug on the spell "Holy Aura" on the paladin. The spell would only do initial damage to the enemy. (Now does damage after the initial collision on a set timer)
[*] Fixed the Summons only doing initial damage on collision. (They now do damage on a set timer even after initial collision) 
[*] Fixed a bug on the spell "Holy Barrier" on the paladin. The spell would only do initial damage to the enemy. (Now does damage after the initial collision on a set timer)
[*] Fixed a bug where the enemy would be pushed out of the arena and get stuck outside of it.
[/list]
